profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer @ Qualus | Computer Science Degree
profile.summary:
As a Senior Software Engineer at Qualus, my focus is on leading our team through complex migrations from legacy systems to cutting-edge Tibco, Java, WebLogic, and AWS microservice architectures. With a strong background in technical leadership from my tenure at Computer World Services Corp, I have honed an agile approach to software development that ensures quality and timely delivery.

My domain knowledge in web services and system integrations, paired with certifications in Data Science and Java Full Stack, has been instrumental in providing innovative solutions and support for our transition to cloud environments. At the heart of my professional ethos is a commitment to mentoring junior team members and fostering an environment where technical excellence and collaborative spirit drive our success.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Works closely with the team lead and technical lead to migrate TIBCO ESB TSS functionalities to Java / Maven / Jenkins / SpringBoot/ AWS microservice platform.
• Provides Java / SpringBoot / SQL development, testing and support for migration into AWS environment.
• Provides technical and domain knowledge for legacy ESB TSS for smooth migration to new micro services architecture.

positions.title: Technical Team Lead
positions.description:
•	Assists the Project Manager in ensuring that an agile and disciplined approach that adheres to quality standards is utilized in the development of the User Stories.
•	Works closely with the Project Manager and focuses on story delivery and priorities, keeps the Project Manager informed of status and impediments.
•	Works closely with all the team members, coordinates the team’s delivery of the capabilities/approved scope.
•	Provides technical leadership to the team, motivates the team, protects the team from outside issues/churn, and assists and holds the team to its process.
•	Schedules and facilitates team meetings as needed.
•	Works closely with Project Manager and Product Owner to understand the stories being developed and removes logistical and technical impediments or roadblocks for the team to ensure the team’s commitment is delivered.  They identify workarounds and expedite exceptions.
•	Communicates with the Project Manager about the resource needs and ensures that the SA leadership is aware of the needs as well.
•	Coordinates and interfaces with other Agile teams to make sure a coordinated solution is developed and delivered by the team as well as coordinates the build and code merge issues with other Agile teams and keep the team informed of build logistics and environment update.

positions.title: Application Engineer 3
positions.description:
Technical Lead / Senior Application Engineer for Transformation Support Services				

Responsibilities:
•	Currently responsible as technical lead and lead developer in enhancing and maintaining clients ESB Transformation Support Services and its other application implemented in Tibco BW, Tibco EMS, Tibco Hawk and Java Testing Harness and Unix/Ant/Jenkins automated deployment Tools. 
•	Participates in analysis, design, support and documentation of TSS Tibco BW/EMS/Hawk architecture, design and processes.
•	Provides production support for all TSS web services and agents in all development, staging and production environments. 
•	Coordinates with Service and Project owners in delivering target stories/tasks for each Agile Sprints.

Tasks involved:
•	Tibco BW development and support for TSS enhancements to accept new forms and new web service.
•	Tibco EMS configuration and support for TSS new queues, routes, bridges and topics
•	Tibco BW Administration configuration and support for TSS updated EAR files and supporting EAR 
files.
•	Tibco Hawk rules for service monitoring and clean up
•	Unix scripting for file shared and backup files maintenance
•	Stored Procedure and SQL design and investigation and reporting
•	Java Test Harness Tool Development and support to provide new summary functionality
•	Analysis and design on Project development and release for TSS enhancements.
•	Provided integration and QA testing support and documentation tasks.
•	Automate daily builds and unit testing using Jenkins

positions.title: Tibco Developer
positions.locationName: San Diego County, California, United States
positions.description:
ESP is Cricket Communications (Client) middleware platform that is responsible on integrating both internal and external services mainly implemented using SOA web services architecture. Architected in multiple layers for  better abstraction of functionality with each layers communicates via the BUS and the payload on the BUS conforming to a common data model. Below are some of the Tibco projects I implemented.

•	Implemented a generic web services in ESP using Tibco BW and Tibco EMS with external calls to outside vendors (FedEx / UPS/ USPS) exposed web services. Re-exposing them as a one generic service for internal sub application usage.
•	Implemented a new adapter in ESP with a stored procedure and a web service call to handle exclusive rate agreement between Cricket and external partner vendor (Walmart). 

Tasks involved:
•	Tibco BW development and support for ESP to call new stored procedure and new web service request development.
•	New Tibco EMS configuration and support for the new forms and EMS as SOAP transport
•	Tibco BW Administration configuration and support for updated related EAR files deployment
•	Analysis and design on ESP development and release.

positions.title: Software Engineer (OOCL USA)
positions.description:
•	Implementation of various workflow processes in Oracle BPEL and TIBCO Business Works  with link up to Oracle DB, TIBCO EMS and web services.
•	Implemented Java applications with Toplink, JDBC, Xerces, JAXP, Tibco EMS 	    and XML beans.
•	Implementation of various Oracle PLSQL functions, procedures and triggers.  
•	Implementation of web services exposed from Java to be called on C#.
•	Implementation of web services exposed from Java to be called on Oracle BPEL.
•	Implementation of web services exposed from Java to be called on Tibco BW	 	   workflows invocation and web services exposed from Smalltalk/Gemstone to Tibco BW invocation. 
•	Implementation and setup several OM in Java/Smalltalk/Gemstone and DB schemas in Sybase/Oracle.
•	Implemented and supported various applications in Java, Smalltalk, Unix, Oracle, Tibco and Sybase.  Implemented numerous XML/XSD for payload interface and application usage.
•	Created various Proof of Concept applications to test functionality and usability of new tools such as Oracle BPEL workflows, Smalltalk / Gemstone, Tibco EMS link up, Tibco Workflows and Java applications implementing newly proposed object models.

positions.title: Team Lead (OOCL Philippines)
positions.description:
•	Implementation of various application  in Mainframe using COBOL1, COBOL2, CICS, VSAM, JCLs, DB2, SPUFI, Easytrieve, TSO applications.
•	Coached team members to achieve goals and developing necessary skills that get results
•	Managing the day-to-day activities of the TEMPO team development, production support, design and meetings.
•	Provide team leadership and coaching · Focus the team on the tasks at hand or the internal and external customer requirements
